translations.web: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
translations.bsb: Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor, he too shall cry out and receive no answer.
translations.kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
translations.asv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, He also shall cry, but shall not be heard.
